scope: Repeatedly inspected local source-closed development folds; not an independent blind test or universal rule.

cases.observed: B increased ASA S errors 2074 to 4154 and M errors 318 to 326; C increased S errors to 4002. B had zero improving folds and no mechanism advantage over C.
cases.required_action: Do not promote or extend this branch on lower loss, added capacity, or an attractive single slice. Any new representation trial must beat a fresh base and capacity control on full original-row M/S counts, folds, and source groups.

cases.observed: Among 2046 source-29 S records newly missed by B, 1884 remain wrong when the trained B branch is disabled; the joint fit changed the base path, not only inference residual votes.
cases.required_action: Before claiming a branch-specific mechanism, compare full joint model with a saved-weight branch-off ablation and distinguish direct residual effects from base-path co-adaptation. Do not reinterpret this postfit intervention as a randomized causal fit.

cases.observed: In source group 29, all 4017 S rows occur on Jul 26 while 32 M rows do; this can create an apparent label shortcut without establishing a security criterion.
cases.required_action: Separate calendar/source associations from protocol, action, direction, endpoint, and verified parameter evidence. Retain harmless-header stress checks and full class counts.

cases.observed: 2044 of B's 2046 newly missed source-29 S rows have no identical normalized body in the other training folds. This is an exact-string coverage statement, not proof of absent shared semantics.
cases.required_action: For any future remedy, audit source-closed support at multiple observable behavior resolutions and distinguish unseen string, unseen parameter combination, and missing class evidence.
